activity.feed.description: Owner-scoped activity. Optional STANDARD OAuth-only ephemeral safe operation details: redacted paths, cwd, selected safe command names. Never returns raw commands, file contents or output.
activity.feed.title: Read live CommandCore activity

activity.watch.description: Open a live, expandable operation timeline INSIDE this ChatGPT conversation (MCP Apps). Call once before a multi-step device task when the user wants to watch what the AI does. Each step can show authorized redacted command, working directory, target file, status and duration. This is not a separate web dashboard.
activity.watch.title: Show CommandCore activity in chat

agents.approval.inbox.description: Read-only owner-scoped proposals awaiting authenticated user review. No message content, no approval, and no desktop input. This tool cannot authorize delivery.
agents.approval.inbox.title: Pending collaboration approvals

agents.deliver.description: Requires FULL_CONTROL; opens a native approval dialog on the device. If declined or unattended no message is sent. If approved revalidates window/process identity and attempts one submission. Does not claim an AI reply.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

agents.deliver.title: Request approval for draft delivery

agents.observe.description: Read-only screenshot and xdotool-root window geometry for an existing X11 window; no conversation identity is inferred and no GUI input occurs.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

agents.observe.title: Observe existing agent window

agents.prepare.description: Save a private ten-minute one-use draft bound to the exact window title. input_x and input_y are absolute xdotool-root coordinates from agents.observe window_geometry, NOT wmctrl positions. No GUI input or submission occurs. Local human approval and FULL_CONTROL remain required for delivery.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

input_x.description: X coordinate in xdotool-root absolute screen coordinates

input_y.description: Y coordinate in xdotool-root absolute screen coordinates

agents.prepare.title: Prepare private draft only

agents.sessions.description: Read-only inventory of running AI applications and graphical windows; session and conversation identity is not inferred from a process.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

agents.sessions.title: Discover existing agent sessions

auth.whoami.description: Show only the verified identity, issuer, OAuth scopes and effective device grants. Never returns credentials.
auth.whoami.title: My identity and access

clipboard.read.description: Read text from the interactive user's clipboard.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

clipboard.read.title: Read clipboard

clipboard.write.description: Replace the interactive user's clipboard text. Requires STANDARD/FULL_CONTROL.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

clipboard.write.title: Write clipboard

commandcore.watch.description: Combined, read-only MCP Apps dashboard with Live Activity and optional Live Browser monitor. Browser control still requires its own OAuth scope.
commandcore.watch.title: Show CommandCore Live Views

desktop.focus.description: Activate an existing X11 window using its discovered window ID.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

desktop.focus.title: Focus desktop window

desktop.pause.description: Block further remote GUI input until the local user resumes via the CommandCore desktop control on the device.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

desktop.pause.title: Yield desktop to human

desktop.windows.description: List visible top-level desktop windows when the device has an interactive GUI session.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

desktop.windows.title: List desktop windows

devices.info.description: Get one device. Pass device_id, selection_id, or device_ref (exact display name/hostname).

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

devices.info.title: Device information

devices.list.description: List devices authorized for the current owner, including online status, immutable ID, platform, capabilities, and permission profile.
devices.list.title: List devices

devices.select.description: Resolve an exact device ID/name/hostname and mint a logical selection handle. MCP 2026 is stateless, so pass returned selection_id to later tools. Explicit device_id always overrides selection_id.

device.description: Immutable ID, exact display name, or exact hostname.

devices.select.title: Select device

docker.ps.description: List Docker containers. Docker daemon access is treated as FULL_CONTROL because it is root-equivalent on typical Linux hosts.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

docker.ps.title: List containers

execution.timeline.description: Read bounded, conversation-specific ordered execution events. Only authenticated STANDARD OAuth and current device grants may see details. No filesystem payloads, arbitrary shell arguments or unapproved command output are exposed.
execution.timeline.title: Read live execution timeline

execution.timeline.watch.description: Open one conversation-scoped live operation timeline with verified device activity, bounded authorized terminal output and file summaries. Activity and Browser existing views remain available.
execution.timeline.watch.title: Watch live execution timeline

fs.copy.description: Copy a file or directory on one device.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.copy.title: Copy file

fs.delete.description: Delete a file or directory. Recursive directory deletion requires recursive=true.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.delete.title: Delete path

fs.list.description: List directory entries on a selected device.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.list.title: List directory

fs.move.description: Move or rename a file or directory on one device.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.move.title: Move file

fs.patch.description: Apply exact search/replace patches to a UTF-8 regular file. Symlinks are refused unless follow_symlinks=true. Fails if a search block is missing or ambiguous unless replace_all=true.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.patch.title: Patch text file

fs.read.description: Read a bounded portion of a text or binary file. Binary data is returned base64 when encoding=base64.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.read.title: Read file

fs.search.description: Search names and optionally UTF-8 text below a root without following symlink directories. On capable Agents, exclude_dirs skips exact directory names (for example target, node_modules, .git); max_file_bytes bounds text scanning. Defaults preserve existing searches; .gitignore is not interpreted.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.search.title: Search files

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.write.description: Write or append text/base64 data using the Agent user's OS privileges. Requires STANDARD or FULL_CONTROL.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.write.title: Write file

git.diff.description: Return a bounded Git diff. Supports staged and path filters.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

git.diff.title: Git diff

git.log.description: Return recent Git commits as structured records.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

git.log.title: Git log

git.run.description: Run a Git subcommand using argv (no shell interpolation). Requires STANDARD or FULL_CONTROL.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

git.run.title: Run Git

git.status.description: Return porcelain Git status for a repository without invoking a shell.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

git.status.title: Git status

keyboard.keypress.description: Send a key or key chord to the focused desktop application.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

keyboard.keypress.title: Press keys

keyboard.type.description: Type text into the focused desktop application. Requires STANDARD/FULL_CONTROL.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

keyboard.type.title: Type text

mouse.click.description: Move the pointer to absolute screen coordinates and click. Requires STANDARD/FULL_CONTROL and an interactive desktop session.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

mouse.click.title: Click desktop

mouse.drag.description: Drag between two bounded X11 screen coordinates.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

mouse.drag.title: Drag desktop pointer

mouse.move.description: Move the native X11 mouse pointer without clicking.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

mouse.move.title: Move desktop pointer

mouse.scroll.description: Scroll in the active X11 application.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

mouse.scroll.title: Scroll desktop

process.list.description: List OS processes visible to the Agent user. filter is a case-insensitive literal substring, never regex. On capable Linux Agents, contains_any is OR over literals; pid, parent_pid, uid and Linux single-letter state narrow with AND. CPU time is cumulative seconds, RSS is resident host memory, not GPU memory.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

process.list.title: List processes

process.output.description: Read captured stdout/stderr for a process started by CommandCore. Existing external OS processes generally do not expose historical stdout and return output_unavailable. New native Linux captures expose per-stream retained/observed bytes, truncated, complete and last_output_at. Legacy truncation is unknown; incomplete capture cannot prove complete output.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

process.output.title: Process output

process.start.description: Start a shell command and return a process_id. Native Linux Rust Agents retain bounded job output and reconcile jobs across transport and Agent restarts. Legacy Agents retain output while running. Host reboot ends jobs; it does not automatically resume them.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

process.start.title: Start managed process

process.status.description: Inspect a CommandCore-managed process_id or an OS pid.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

process.status.title: Process status

process.stop.description: Terminate a CommandCore-managed process; may also signal an OS pid when permitted.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

process.stop.title: Stop process

screen.capture.description: Capture the current interactive desktop as PNG/base64. Requires an active desktop session on the target device.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

screen.capture.title: Capture screen

shell.exec.description: Execute a command through the device's default shell. This is intentionally powerful and requires STANDARD/FULL_CONTROL. Output is bounded and audited; secrets should not be passed in command text.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

shell.exec.title: Execute shell command

system.info.description: Return hostname, OS, architecture, Python/Agent versions, boot time and hardware summary.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

system.info.title: System information

system.metrics.description: Return current CPU, memory, disk and load metrics. Capable Linux Agents also return health with contextual pressure conditions, Linux PSI, and optional accelerator utilization/memory plus compute PIDs. Unsupported metrics are explicit; unified/GPU memory can overlap host RAM. No automatic cleanup or termination.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

system.metrics.title: System metrics

transfer.download.description: Download a bounded file as base64. For large files a future streaming transfer capability will replace this Phase 1 mechanism.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

transfer.download.title: Download file

transfer.upload.description: Upload base64 data to a file on the selected device. Phase 1 payloads are bounded by server configuration.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

transfer.upload.title: Upload file
